name: EA_MARSI_1-02
summary: This EA uses a dual EMA-smoothed RSI crossover system to identify trend reversals. A slow and a fast EMA_RSI_VA indicator generate signals when they cross: a bullish crossover opens a buy, a bearish crossover opens a sell, closing any existing opposite position first. It supports optional dynamic lot sizing based on account balance and a configurable drawdown cap.
summary_zh: 该EA使用双EMA平滑RSI交叉系统来识别趋势反转。慢速和快速EMA_RSI_VA指标交叉时产生信号：金叉开多，死叉开空，同时平掉原有反向仓位。支持基于账户余额和最大回撤的可选动态仓位计算。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于EMA平滑后的RSI交叉，通过慢速和快速两条EMA_RSI_VA线的交叉来捕捉趋势转折点。入场条件为：当慢线上穿快线时买入，当慢线下穿快线时卖出，且仅在新的K线开盘时判断信号以避免重复交易。出场条件依赖反向交叉信号平仓并反手，同时支持设置固定TP和SL。仓位管理方面，默认使用固定手数，开启use_Multpl后根据账户余额与最大回撤的比值动态调整仓位。资金管理通过Max_drawdown参数限制最大回撤，并对超过品种最大手数的情况进行截断处理。SL/TP设置采用循环重试机制（N_modify_sltp次），每次间隔1秒，以提高订单修改的成功率。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on EMA-smoothed RSI crossovers, using the crossing of slow and fast EMA_RSI_VA lines to capture trend turning points. Entry conditions: buy when the slow line crosses above the fast line, sell when the slow line crosses below the fast line, with signals evaluated only on new bar openings to prevent duplicate trades. Exit conditions rely on opposite crossover signals to close and reverse positions, with optional fixed TP and SL support. Position sizing defaults to fixed lots, but when use_Multpl is enabled, it dynamically adjusts lot size based on the ratio of account balance to Max_drawdown. Money management uses the Max_drawdown parameter to cap maximum drawdown exposure and truncates lots that exceed the symbol's maximum volume limit. SL/TP modification employs a retry loop (up to N_modify_sltp attempts) with 1-second intervals between attempts to improve order modification success rates.

parameters.name: magic
parameters.description: 订单魔术号，用于识别EA订单
parameters.description_en: Order magic number for EA order identification

parameters.name: N_modify_sltp
parameters.description: SL/TP修改失败后最大重试次数
parameters.description_en: Maximum retry count for SL/TP modification failures

parameters.name: use_Multpl
parameters.description: 是否启用动态仓位计算
parameters.description_en: Whether to enable dynamic position sizing

parameters.name: Max_drawdown
parameters.description: 动态仓位计算中的最大回撤参考值
parameters.description_en: Maximum drawdown reference for dynamic position sizing

pros: 使用EMA平滑RSI减少噪音信号，双周期交叉策略逻辑清晰
有新K线判断机制，避免同一根K线内重复交易
支持动态仓位管理，可根据账户余额自动调整手数
SL/TP修改有重试机制，提高了订单修改的可靠性
pros_en: EMA-smoothed RSI reduces noise signals; dual-period crossover strategy logic is clear and well-structured
New bar detection prevents duplicate trades within the same candle
Dynamic lot sizing based on account balance provides proportional risk scaling
SL/TP modification retry mechanism improves order modification reliability
cons: 默认SL和TP均为0，未设置止损止盈，存在较大风险敞口
仅支持单品种单仓位交易，无法处理多仓位或对冲情况
close()函数中未正确处理OrderSend失败，GetLastError()调用但未使用返回值
缺少点差过滤、交易时间过滤等风控机制
PositionSelect使用Symbol()而非magic号筛选，可能误操作其他EA的仓位
cons_en: Default SL and TP are both 0, meaning positions have no protective stop-loss or take-profit, creating significant risk exposure
Only supports single-symbol single-position trading, cannot handle multiple positions or hedging scenarios
The close() function improperly handles OrderSend failure — GetLastError() is called but its return value is unused
Lacks spread filter, trading session filter, and other common risk control mechanisms
PositionSelect uses Symbol() instead of magic number filtering, potentially interfering with positions from other EAs
improvements: 应添加默认止损和止盈值，或强制要求用户设置SL以防止无限亏损
使用magic号筛选仓位而非仅用Symbol()，避免与其他EA的仓位冲突
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在高点差或低流动性时段交易
close()函数应正确获取并处理错误码，而非丢弃GetLastError()的返回值
improvements_en: Add default or mandatory SL/TP values to prevent unlimited loss exposure when users leave them at 0
Use magic number to filter positions instead of Symbol() alone, avoiding conflicts with positions from other EAs
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid trading during high-spread or low-liquidity periods
Fix the close() function to properly capture and handle the error code from GetLastError() instead of discarding it

risk_points: 默认SL和TP为0，仓位无止损保护，可能造成大额亏损
仓位筛选仅依赖Symbol()而非magic号，可能误平其他EA的仓位
缺少点差和交易时段过滤，可能在不适宜条件下入场
risk_points_en: Default SL/TP of 0 leaves positions without stop-loss protection, risking significant losses
Position selection relies on Symbol() rather than magic number, risking accidental closure of other EAs' positions
No spread or session filters may cause entries under unfavorable market conditions
